notes: Control point map for game-fatal-contact: team spawns become red/blue spawns, control points and resupply are kept as markers, flag_spawns place a capture-the-flag layout at each team's last control point. Textures and models are free replacements; published as a credited community map with a removal offer.
kind_why: A control point map played as deathmatch, team deathmatch and capture the flag: built to fight on rather than to time.
